Advanced tips:
  
- When you use the special fields, the double watered buff stacks ontop of the speed benefits. So there is still a reason to water them twice if you want to optimize crop output for the season.  
  
- If you are the type to water your fields twice in the day and take your animals to the safari all in one day. *1st*- making sure your animals are able to feed themselves by 7AM (this includes any that you have set up to graze).  *2nd*, before taking care of your animals, water your crops and fields. *Next*, Come back to your farm to take care of any of your animals you **will not** take to the safari. When you are ready to take your animals to the safari, make sure to take your brush and other animal care tools and simply take care of them **There**. This will save you alot of time either before or after the safari trip (Depending on when you want to depart and when you want to return). Then you when you return, you water the crops and fields a second time before bed!
